review: Let’s look at what Sinclair was before his Dawn allies. His clashes were underwhelming, damage non-existent aside from S3-2, which by modern standards is still non-existent. His main strengths were Burn infliction and AoE access for s2. His rolls were quite decent, but S1 was underwhelming in that regard. His main flaw was SP management, since after turn 4, he has basically been doomed to lose clashes randomly due to very low SP. Now, what did his 2 allies change? Faust provided him with rolls and damage upscale, making his S1 less underwhelming to use for clash due to heightened standards, making his S2 really strong in terms of damage, and basically made his S3-2 damage on the same level, if not higher than HoS Ryoshu’s S3-1.
